svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif

text.tspan: Fishing intensity measures the extent to which a stock is being exploited. Here, it's measured as current fishing
intensity divided by the intensity at the maximum sustainable yield. A value of one is the optimal level to
maximize fish catch without causing fish population. Greater than one suggests overfishing.
